Goal:
  Alpha counts its calls. Beta reads the count!
  Gamma stores nothing yet.

Contract:
  ### Requirement: Alpha counts
  Alpha SHALL count its calls.
  
  #### Scenario: Alpha counts
  - **WHEN** alpha is called twice
  - **THEN** its count is two

Tasks:
  [ ] 1. When alpha is called, it counts [pending]
      Verify: node --test tests/alpha.test.ts
      Scope: src/alpha.ts, tests/alpha.test.ts, package.json
      Acceptance:
        - [ ] Alpha counts each call.
        - [ ] The count starts at zero.
  [ ] 2. When gamma is new, it stores the count [pending]

      Acceptance:
        - [ ] Gamma stores the count alpha gives it.
  [ ] 3. When beta reads the count, it prints it [pending]
      Verify: node scripts/print-count.mjs
      Scope: src/beta.ts
      Acceptance:
        - [ ] Beta prints the count.
